messages.content: Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.
Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.

samples.text: Floating-point addition is not associative because the order in which numbers are added can affect the result due to rounding errors and the way floating-point numbers are represented in memory. When adding three numbers, the intermediate result may be rounded to a different value than if the numbers were added in a different order, leading to a different final result. This non-associativity can cause problems in certain algorithms and calculations, particularly those that rely on the commutative and associative properties of arithmetic operations.
